definitions.hardguard25_identifier: A nonempty sequence whose canonical form contains only characters from the HardGuard25 alphabet.
definitions.payload: The identifier characters before an optional check digit.
definitions.normalization: Removal of the separators and exact Unicode White_Space set allowed by the specification, followed by uppercasing and alphabet validation.
definitions.check_digit: An optional final HardGuard25 character computed from the payload by the specification's weighted mod-25 algorithm.
definitions.producer_conformance: Generation of uppercase identifiers containing only HardGuard25 alphabet characters and following the claimed check-digit behavior.
definitions.consumer_conformance: Acceptance of conforming identifiers after specified normalization and rejection of invalid input.
definitions.human_safe: A design goal based on excluding common visual confusables, not a measured guarantee of error-free reading, typing, speech, or OCR.

evidence_boundaries: Passing conformance tests does not establish global uniqueness for a consuming system.
The alphabet's exclusions are documented design choices; comparative OCR and transcription error rates have not been established empirically.
Repository source, published packages, and deployed website bytes are separate release states.
